method: AI-assisted initial analyst screen with per-example identities/outcomes masked; not independent human validation
access_before_recording: All 20 three-camera uniform-frame overviews and label-free task instructions; additional full sequences B09 high, B11 left wrist, B18 left wrist, B02 high
limitations: One observer; coarse uniform samples; no inter-rater reliability; apparent task outcomes are observations, not replacement labels
